{{Youmay|the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] priest|a [[Reader/Legends|device]] used to read [[Dataplaque/Legends|data plaques]]}}
A '''reader''' was a [[Yuuzhan Vong]] who would use the intel gained on enemies and transfer it into a [[Blaze bug/Legends|blaze bug]] swarm. Readers were also [[Priest/Legends|priests]], which allowed them to ensure that [[Yun'o|gods]] other than [[Yun-Yammka]] held the same significance.
